title: Auto Refill & Medication Sync Program Schedule: Unpicked-Fill Limit, Re-Enrollment Wait and Annual Consent
content:
Three program figures of Auto Refill & Medication Sync bear on how long an enrollment runs and when a prescription can come back: the number of automated fills in a row returned to stock unpicked that ends the enrollment, the wait before a prescription whose enrollment the program ended may be enrolled again, and whether consent must be renewed every program year.

| Program | Automated fills in a row returned to stock unpicked that end the enrollment | Calendar days after the program ended the enrollment before the same prescription may be enrolled again | Patient must renew consent every program year |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day | 2 | 30 | No |
| Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day | 2 | 30 | No |
| Kestrel Med Sync Monthly | 2 | 60 | No |
| Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day | 2 | 60 | No |
| Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging | 2 | 60 | No |
| Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill | 3 | 30 | Yes |

## Column notes

- The unpicked-fill limit is a whole number of automated fills in a row that were returned to stock without being picked up.
- The re-enrollment wait is a whole number of calendar days.
- Annual consent renewal is a yes-or-no switch.

## Grouped by figure

- Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill stands apart on two columns: its unpicked-fill limit is 3 (every other program: 2) and it is the only program requiring consent to be renewed every program year.
- The re-enrollment wait is 30 calendar days for the three Auto Refill programs (Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day, Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day, Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill) and 60 calendar days for the three Med Sync programs.
